notes:
I found three real programs for toddlers in Halton Hills. The first two are at Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre. The third is a Town of Halton Hills dance class with a parent.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Parent and Tot, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre (36 Armstrong Avenue, Georgetown)",
      "age_fit": "18 months - 3.11 yrs",
      "when": "Fall 2026 session Sept 12 - Dec 18 (30-minute classes; a fall schedule PDF is on their site)",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    },
    {
      "name": "Pre-school Drop In, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre (36 Armstrong Avenue, Georgetown)",
      "age_fit": "Pre-school age children under 4, with a parent",
      "when": "Tuesdays and Thursdays 9:30am - 12:00pm, during the school year (Sept - Jun)",
      "price": "$15 for one parent and up to 4 children",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    },
    {
      "name": "Tiny Dancers, Gellert Community Centre (10241 8 Line, Georgetown)",
      "age_fit": "2-3 yrs",
      "when": "Saturdays 8:30 AM - 9:00 AM, Sep 26 - Dec 12",
      "price": "$117.00 for 12 classes",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills Recreation"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes for the follow-up:
- **Parent and Tot:** The fall session started Sept 12, and registration opened July 20 on their site. The schedule PDF lists several class times, but I couldn't tie any one day and time to this class from the text I could read. No price was shown for this class.
- **Drop In:** The pages don't agree on the start date (Sept 15 on one, Oct 9 on others) or on the holiday closure (Dec 18 or Dec 22 to Jan 5). The days, times and $15 fee are consistent across their pages. No pre-registration is needed, and it is first come.
- **Tiny Dancers:** The fall table lists the age, day, time, dates and fee. The "one adult participates" requirement appeared only on the spring 2026 page, so I left it out of the pick.
